up: Return the public ChEMBL IDs (chembl_id) and preferred names (pref_name) for all molecules reported in the document with the identifier CHEMBL5728477. Use the compound_records table to link the document to the molecules, and then join with molecule_dictionary to retrieve the identifiers and names. Return each molecule only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728477'
